cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: CWE-116 requires improper encoding/escaping when preparing structured messages for communication. This function sets boolean DOM properties (link.disabled) based on string comparison, not encoding output for communication protocols.

connection.evidence: External input from cookies/query parameters flows to stylesheet selection via string comparison with link.title values, enabling/disabling stylesheet elements.

diff_causality.evidence: This function addition creates the stylesheet selection mechanism that uses external input without validation. Reverting would remove this functionality entirely.

security_control.required_control: output encoding for structured message communication
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-116 requires encoding when preparing structured messages for communication between components
existing_controls_checked: direct string comparison with link.title values
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No encoding is performed, but the operation is DOM property setting, not message preparation for communication protocols

concrete_impact.evidence: Potential UI manipulation through stylesheet switching, but CWE-116's specific impact of message structure corruption is not demonstrated

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the stylesheet selection functionality would be removed entirely, eliminating the external input flow to DOM manipulation.
supporting_evidence: External input from cookies/query parameters flows to stylesheet selection
No validation of sheet parameter against allowed values
Direct string comparison used for stylesheet matching
contradicting_evidence: CWE-116 requires improper encoding when preparing structured messages for communication, but this function sets DOM properties, not encodes messages
The operation is boolean property assignment, not output encoding for communication protocols
unresolved_facts: Whether stylesheet titles are fixed or can include arbitrary values
